verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions is Gitea's own CI/CD engine. Users write GitHub Actions-compatible YAML workflows that run on Gitea's action runners, which gives event-driven background automation. The evidence covers only CI/CD-style workflows and says nothing about recurring scheduled runs or agent-driven autonomous tasks, so the 'run autonomously in the background' part is only partly shown. missing for 10: documented recurring/cron schedule triggers, evidence of autonomous agent-style background tasks beyond CI/CD, hands-on corroboration of background workflow execution

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
an action runner for Gitea Action
